plugins.name: hive
plugins.description: Plan, track, and move work forward in Hive with project, action, approval, resource, timesheet, and CRM workflows.

skills.name: meeting-follow-up
skills.description: Turn meeting notes or the current conversation into a reviewed set of Hive actions with owners, projects, and dates, then create them only after the user confirms the proposed changes. Use for meeting follow-ups, action-item capture, or converting decisions into Hive work.
skills.description_zh: 将会议笔记或当前对话转为带负责人、项目和日期的 Hive 行动建议，供复核并经用户确认后创建，适用于会议跟进和决策转任务。

skills.name: project-status
skills.description: Build a concise, evidence-backed status report for a Hive project, including progress, overdue work, blockers, owners, approvals, and next actions. Use when the user asks for project status, project health, blockers, risks, or a stakeholder update from Hive.
skills.description_zh: 依据 Hive 项目证据生成简短状态报告，包含进展、逾期、阻塞、负责人、审批与下一步。

skills.name: weekly-plan
skills.description: Build a realistic weekly plan from the user's assigned Hive work, prioritizing overdue items, deadlines, blockers, approvals, and dependencies. Use when the user asks what to work on, to plan the week, or to prioritize current Hive actions.
skills.description_zh: 根据分派给用户的 Hive 工作制定现实周计划，优先考虑逾期、期限、阻塞、审批和依赖。
